SRC-348:R003.text: Under a blocked or reauthentication-required gate, strictly read-only investigation is permitted and every state-changing bypass is prohibited; CLI replay of operator ingress must fail and authenticated operator-carrier ingress must be verified
SRC-348:R003.verification: Read-only investigation stays permitted under a blocked or reauthentication-required gate while every state change is refused: fleet answers read only true with needs local mutation false, and gate decision returns RECONCILE_REAUTH_REQUIRED for a missing or invalid authority Source, a different project identity or a different gate version. SRC-348:R004.text: Audit ledgers must not be declarable as completely VERIFIED from aggregate pytest counts: test-node identities must be unique, bound to a source revision, and checked per mechanism with independently checkable terminal dispositions
SRC-348:R004.verification: An audit ledger cannot be declared completely verified from aggregate pytest counts. Shard merging requires one shared inventory digest and selected position lists that cover every discovered occurrence exactly once, so a duplicate, omission or substitution sets a partition error; the partition proof is persisted in the run record. Each record is bound to the exact tested bytes by a tree fingerprint plus a verification identity, and the cache loader refuses a record whose fingerprint, identity or family differ, so a record cannot float to another revision. Coverage is derived per clause rather than in aggregate, and the generic-proof guard refuses core-suite, aggregate-pass and discovery-wide phrasing as proof of a live-acceptance clause. SRC-348:R005.text: An operator requirement must be distinguishable from a requirement an agent derived from a larger specification: track operator_source, derived_requirement and agent_hypothesis as separate provenance classes and never present an inferred requirement as an original operator instruction
SRC-348:R005.verification: Requirement provenance is carried as separate witness classes and not blended. Each user instruction receipt records one witness among operator carrier, transport obligation and model supplied; an unwitnessed request is recorded as model supplied and that class is not itself a refusal, while only a carrier witness may project user explicit authority, preempt active Work or pivot a goal. SRC-348:R006.text: The response contract must be enforced against actual output: the active reply language and style are bound to the session and validated, with no repeated tool execution on a format retry
SRC-348:R006.verification: The response contract is enforced against the reply text rather than asserted: the check and render commands are a single read-only renderer and checker that consume the reply on stdin and decide mandatory field presence, canonical order, last-position details and a wait that names a human action. The active reply language and style are bound to the session by resolving the running style contract, so the emitted digest uses the session language instead of the caller's. A format retry re-enters that pure read-only validator, which has no tool dispatch, so reformatting a reply cannot re-execute the work it describes.
